trap.label: colocação
trap.wrong: We made a target for next year.
trap.right: We set a target for next year.
trap.why: Em português “fazer/colocar uma meta” parece natural, então o aluno traduz com make ou put. A colocação em inglês é set a target/goal.

mcq.q: Which verb forms a **fund** for a grant?

fix.wrong: They made up a pilot grant last year.
fix.right: They set up a pilot grant last year.

fix.wrong: Please set a side two hours for the review.
fix.right: Please set aside two hours for the review.

fix.wrong: The report sets in your aims clearly.
fix.right: The report sets out your aims clearly.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com set up: “They created a research foundation.”
rewrite.answer: They set up a research foundation.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com set aside: “We reserved a week for scoring.”
rewrite.answer: We set aside a week for scoring.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com set a target: “The team established a goal.”
